scope: The real launcher (LauncherWindow, SessionWorker, LauncherSession; host and join) with native games and no emulator: a native runtime bundle (the Windows exe and its SDL2.dll, run under Wine; or the Linux executable under the bundle's .exe name with a placeholder SDL2.dll; the launcher's own bundle and installation checks ran either way), production world creation, host enrollment of both legacy saves through bootstrap games that close themselves, the friend's invitation; both launchers start their games, which Continue into the overworld; the host opens Start > Player > Players, picks Battle Friend and Challenge 1v1; the friend opens Pending challenge and accepts; both press Enter battle; default moves until the battle ends, with the forced switch when the host's first Pokemon faints; both launchers report battle_finished with the original game processes, bridges and runtime identities; the durable result is the same for both; each player's full personal party is back in memory; each game's Players > Challenges > Recent battle results shows it; both save through the launcher (revision 2); both games close normally (exit 0: SIGTERM on Linux, Alt+F4 under Wine); fresh launchers Continue onto the same canonical saves; the host store passes its integrity check; source saves unchanged. Ordinary key presses on each player's own X display; the harness reads the games' memory (/proc/PID/mem at the non-PIE executable's symbols) only to see menus, tasks and parties, never writes it.

failed_runs.failure: every 3D game froze at its first battle frame: the 3D battle's backdrop read the trainer class of TRAINER_LINK_OPPONENT (0xFF01), the engine's assertion opened its crash screen on the drawing thread ('include/data.h:260: invalid trainer: 65281', DioramaBattle_Capture > BackdropEnvironment), the answer to START never left the game and the client's 5-second command timeout ended the battle ('Battle recovery could not finish'); the GBA-path checks before it (bind, prepare, trainer blocks) passed
failed_runs.fixed_by: engine bc7a3cfc7 (battle_capture.c: only a real trainer id's class is read); runs 8 and 9 passed with it
